view_map.section: axis +Z runs left to right; datum A is z=0

features.rationale: Turn the annular spacer to nominal finished dimensions; the section confirms a concentric through bore.
Chamfer both bore mouths as explicitly depicted in the section, before machining the interrupting end slot.
features.justification: The section depicts chamfers at both bore/end intersections; TYP is restricted to those depicted edges, not the outside diameter or slot edges.

features.rationale: Mill the centered top end slot from datum A, through the radial wall, stopping at the dimensioned axial depth.
features.justification: The front view and upper detail show the slot centered on the top vertical centerline. The unhatched upper-left region of the section establishes an end slot terminating .75 from datum A. Its radial extent crosses the entire wall: the cutting rectangle starts inside the bore at y=0 and overshoots the OD to y=D001; only the axial termination is blind.

features.rationale: What size and form of edge break should be applied to the remaining sharp outside and slot edges?
features.justification: Zero is a non-executable placeholder for the unspecified edge-break size; listed edges identify representative affected edges, not a resolved complete selection. Do not apply this feature until the break size, form, and slot-edge treatment are specified.

notes: Drawing title: SPACER; drawing number 4092-B; model 100TW. The supplied extraction identifier A040921E is retained as the plan part identifier.

Full sheet explicitly specifies inches, third-angle projection, and material 1018. General tolerances: two-place dimensions ±.02, three-place dimensions ±.010, angular dimensions ±1°, except where individually specified.
Bore D002 has limits 9.002 to 9.004 inches; model uses the printed nominal diameter.
Datum A is the z=0 end face. Opposite end face parallelism to A is D008 (.001); retain as manufacturing/inspection metadata rather than a geometry alteration.

The full-sheet asterisk note reads 'ALLOW .060 STOCK FOR GR. AT ASSY'. This plan represents the nominal finished 3.000-inch length. Retain .060-inch grinding stock in the manufacturing process; the note does not explicitly allocate that stock between faces, so this plan does not invent an as-machined stock distribution.
D009 and D010 are derived extraction values; wall thickness and remaining axial length follow directly from the controlling printed diameters and lengths.
